description: Deletes every question of one webinar, or only the open ones or only the answered ones. Side effect: they are gone from the site and cannot be brought back; no email is sent. Needs `session_id`, `webinar_id`, `scope` and a clear yes (`confirm` true). Read the questions first with wi_get_webinar_questions and tell the host how many would go. To remove a single question use wi_delete_webinar_question.

confirm.description: Must be true, set only after the host said that these questions may be deleted.

scope.description: Which questions to delete: the open ones, the answered ones, or both.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

name: wi_delete_all_webinar_questions
title: Delete a whole set of participant questions
